vn: Numb. iv. 2, 3. Some easier duty was appointed earlier, Numb. viii. 24; 1 Chron. xxiii. 24.

Some think that the meaning of ὡς ἐνομιζετο may be, "as was reckoned in the legal records," ut lege sancitum est. The very same word, however, is used by Herodotus, lib. iv., for one who was only supposed the son of another, τουτου παις νομιζεται, ejus filius censetur.
